blocks.text: When an employee is placed on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP), HR and the employee's manager jointly document the performance goals and success criteria at the start of the PIP period. The PIP period is 90 days.
At day 60 of the PIP, HR and the manager conduct a mid-point check-in to assess progress and provide feedback to the employee.

At day 90, HR and the manager assess the employee's performance. If goals are met, the PIP is closed and a summary note is added to the employee's HR file. If goals are partially met, the PIP may be extended by 30 days; this extension may only occur once. If goals are not met, HR initiates a termination recommendation.
Legal must review any termination recommendation before it is submitted to senior leadership for action.
